[[File:Toby Bengelsdorf Quickies Chicago 2009.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Toby Bengelsdorf reading in Chicago, August 2009.]]
'''Toby Bengelsdorf''' of Port Washington, New York, was a finalist in Decipher's 1997 Design a Card contest and received two [[Special Edition]] booster packs.<ref name="win">[http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Guy Kargl Wins Star Wars CCG Card Design Contest], Rich Loftus, Decipher (23 May 1997). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990210055006/http://www.decipher.com/insidedecipher/archives/1997/designawinner.html Internet Archive]</ref>
